name: bluesky_firehose
contamination_reasoning: Bluesky launched publicly in Feb 2023 and the firehose contains only data created after that date. All data postdates every model cutoff. The platform itself is novel enough that no TSFM pretraining corpus would include it.
difficulty_note: Post arrival rate is bursty with diurnal patterns, viral events, and platform-growth regime shifts. A seasonal-naive baseline would miss growth trends and event-driven spikes entirely.
adapter_notes: WebSocket subscription. Subscribe to com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos for all public posts. Each message is a repo commit containing one or more records. Count posts per time bucket. No auth required for public firehose. High message volume — expect 10-100+ msgs/sec.
verify: Confirm the WebSocket endpoint is stable and that public firehose access requires no auth. Check rate of message arrival to ensure it's feasible to process.

name: smart_citizen_kit_api
estimated_length: Varies per kit; some have years of data, ongoing
contamination_reasoning: Citizen-science air quality network with an obscure API. Very unlikely to appear in any TSFM pretraining corpus. Data is real-time and ongoing, so future values are contamination-free.
difficulty_note: Citizen sensors have noise, calibration drift, gaps from kit downtime, and event-driven spikes (traffic, wildfires, indoor/outdoor placement changes). Diurnal patterns exist but are noisy and non-stationary.
adapter_notes: GET /v0/devices returns device list with last_reading_at. GET /v0/devices/:id/readings returns sensor data. Sensors include PM2.5, CO2, NO2, temperature, humidity, noise. No API key required for basic access. Rate limits unknown — verify.
verify: Confirm API is accessible without auth. Check how many kits are actively reporting. Verify reading frequency (some kits report every 1 min, others less frequently). Check rate limits.

name: opensensemap_api

adapter_notes: GET /boxes returns all senseBoxes with sensor info. GET /boxes/:id/data/:sensorId returns historical measurements. Statistics endpoint at /stats/collections for aggregate counts. No auth required. Data format is JSON.
verify: Confirm API is accessible without auth. Check number of actively reporting senseBoxes. Verify measurement frequency (varies by board type). Check rate limits.
